messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: on-call rotation triggered for svc-inference-gw — high error rate detected (5xx spike). Paging: eng-sre rotation. Please ack and triage.
Priya (SRE): acked. seeing spike in 5xxs from 05:11 -> 05:22 UTC, ~8% error rate on gateway path /v1/generate. No elevated CPU on backends.
Sam (Infra): I’m pulling LB metrics now. Envoy metrics show retries up and a bunch of 502/503 from upstream cluster 'inference-backend-v2'.
Alex (Edge): We rolled a route config change at 05:10 that adjusted route matching and set retry policy to `retries: 2` and circuit_breakers for that cluster at low thresholds. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/edge/+/R23456 (rolling env: canary -> prod)
Jordan (Oncall): timeline looks correlated. If route matching changed traffic to a smaller subset of nodes, backend could be overloaded -> 5xx. Can someone check upstream pod logs?
Maya (Platform): checking pod logs for inference-backend-v2: lots of connection reset / 'connection refused' and occasional 'worker OOM' around 05:12. Also seeing a spike in per-pod connection count.
Priya (SRE): screenshot of graph pasted: frontend  p50 latency up 400ms, 5xx spike from 0.2% -> 8% across region. Most errors are 502 gateway errors.
Sam (Infra): quick mitigation idea: disable retries at the proxy to reduce load amplification. You'll need to patch Envoy route config or set `x-envoy-retry-on: none` header at gateway.
Alex (Edge): I can hotpatch route config on the gateway cluster. Proposed patch: replace `retry_policy` block with `retry_on: ""` for the route. Applying to canary first.
Jordan (Oncall): please apply to canary only then observe for 2 minutes before lifting to prod. If that reduces upstream load we can roll to prod.
Alex (Edge): applying to canary now. command: ```kubectl -n edge apply -f /manifests/envoy/route-disable-retries.yaml```
incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for edge/gateway-route-patch (canary).
Sam (Infra): monitoring: within 60s canary shows per-instance connections lowered 30% and 5xx on canary path dropped to 0.5%. Good signal.
Maya (Platform): but prod still high. looks like only a subset of gateways got the new config due to shard routing. Might need to apply to the other shards or adjust service weights.
Priya (SRE): what's the root cause hypothesis? My read: route change narrowed origin endpoints and lowered circuit_breaker thresholds; combined with retries caused retry amplification and overloaded a few backend pods -> connection resets/502.
Jordan (Oncall): agree. short-term plan: 1) disable retries across gateways 2) increase circuit breaker thresholds for inference-backend-v2 to allow more in-flight connections 3) scale inference-backend-v2 replicas and cordon any OOMing pods.
Alex (Edge): prepping prod patch to disable retries globally for gateway. Will patch all shards sequentially with small window.
Sam (Infra): also increasing cb thresholds: `max_connections: 200`, `max_pending_requests: 1000` on cluster config for inference-backend-v2. Applying now with `kubectl -n infra apply -f /ops/clusters/inference-cb-adjust.yaml`.
Maya (Platform): scaled inference-backend-v2 from 6 -> 12 replicas to soak. Rolling update in progress.
incident-bot: infra-monitor: cluster config apply succeeded.
Priya (SRE): after both mitigations, global 5xx dropped to baseline ~0.3% in 4 minutes. Latency back to normal. Customer-facing errors reduced.
Jordan (Oncall): good. anyone seeing lingering errors?
Alex (Edge): one edge shard lagged during rollout and showed brief second spike; patch retried and succeeded. No ongoing 5xx now.
Sam (Infra): marking incident as mitigated. Scaling/cb changes may mask underlying config bug. Recommend rollback of the route PR R23456 to the previous stable rule for full recovery and postmortem.
Maya (Platform): capturing logs and saving traces for 05:08-05:20 window for postmortem.
Priya (SRE): handoff: I'll take postmortem and coordinate with Edge team for revert + test plan. Jordan, please update customers/channel if needed.
Jordan (Oncall): updating #customer-impact: small percentage of requests for ~12 minutes, some customers saw 502s — writing a short blurb.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring for 1h. Incident handler: Priya (SRE). Postmortem assigned.
Priya (SRE): follow-ups: revert R23456 or add stricter integration tests for route->cluster weight changes, add automated preflight that simulates retry amplification, and add a runbook step to check circuit_breaker bounds after route changes.
Alex (Edge): will open R23457 to revert and add tests.
Sam (Infra): will create a quick dashboard showing per-cluster retry amplification ratio.
Maya (Platform): scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
eng-sre-rotation: acked and stepping off the pager. thanks all.
Priya (SRE): closing thread — resolved. Will attach postmortem when ready.
